preview: A manga can end at an exciting moment, leaving readers wondering what happens next. LINE Manga has introduced a new service connected to that feeling. How might it change the way readers engage with a story?
comment_1: As you listen, notice what LINE Manga’s new service lets readers do.
comment_2: So, byUs lets readers do more than talk with characters; they can help create stories. What can they do with the stories they make?
comment_3: So far, we’ve heard that byUs lets readers create stories with characters, not just chat with them, and choose whether to share those stories. As you listen next, pay attention to what else you learn about using the service.
comment_4: ByUs gives readers a way to move beyond talking with characters and make their own stories using approved works and characters. Now, let’s bring the main idea together.
